days.description: Show dated items up to this many days ahead. Overdue ones always show.

link.description:
Makes each item a link: `{path}` is the file's path under the folder
in `paths`, `{line}` the headline's line. E.g.
`https://github.com/me/org/blob/main/{path}#L{line}`.

paths.description: `.org` files, or folders to search for them. `~/` is expanded.

undated.description: Also list open TODOs that have no date, after the dated ones.

entries.description: An org-mode agenda: open TODO headlines from .org files with their SCHEDULED and DEADLINE dates, overdue first. Reads #+TODO keywords and [#A] priorities.
entries.name: Agenda
